cat > rosterkit/contacts.py <<'EOF'
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student


def _contact_row(student: Student) -> str:
    if not student.email:
        raise ProjectError(f"no email for student: {student.display_name}")
    return f"{student.display_name:<20} {student.section:<8} {student.email}"


# ---
def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Text rows sorted by name: display name, section and email in columns."""
    roster = sorted(students, key=lambda student: student.display_name)
    if not roster:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    return [_contact_row(student) for student in roster]
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student


def make(last, section="A", email="x@example.org"):
    return Student(last.lower(), last, "Pat", section, email)


class ContactRowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_by_name(self):
        rows = contact_rows([make("Young"), make("Adams")])
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].startswith("Adams, Pat"))

    def test_columns_line_up(self):
        rows = contact_rows([make("Li", "B", "li@example.org")])
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], f"{'Li, Pat':<20} {'B':<8} li@example.org")

    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProjectError, "Adams, Pat"):
            contact_rows([make("Young"), make("Adams", email=None)])

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
EOF
